  • Qualify Agent - Cleverconnect Qualify is an AI-powered candidate qualification platform that conducts a real spoken first-round interview with every applicant. Instead of a static form or a one-way video questionnaire, Qualify's conversational AI agent holds an actual voice (or voice + video) conversation with the candidate: it asks the questions defined in your job-specific Assessment Guide, listens to the answers, adapts its follow-ups, and captures everything for structured evaluation. Behind the scenes, Qualify scores each candidate against the criteria that matter for the role and produces a clear, evidence-backed recommendation — Great Match, Good Match, or Review Needed — delivered directly inside Teamtailor. Recruiters no longer spend their days on repetitive screening calls; they open their pipeline and find a ranked shortlist with transcripts, scores and summaries ready to act on. By letting a conversational AI handle the first interview at scale, Qualify gives every candidate a fair, consistent, on-demand chance to make their case — and gives recruiters their time back for the decisions only humans should make.
